name: BlueTape Pay
author: BlueTape

sections.description:
BlueTape Pay for WooCommerce provides an easy way to accept payments directly on your online store via BlueTape. With support for ACH, cards, and trade credit payments, this plugin simplifies the checkout experience and enhances customer satisfaction.

Features:
– Accept ACH transfers and card payments.
– Extended terms options for business customers.
– Secure, fast, and reliable transactions.
– Easy setup and integration with WooCommerce.

Transform Your Checkout Experience
– Boost Sales: Sell to a wider range of customers and increase average order value by offering extended terms at check out.
– Increase Conversion: Reduce cart abandonment and improve conversion by allowing customers to choose the payment option that suits them best.
– Enhance Customer Experience: Simplify the purchasing process, offering customers a more flexible and convenient checkout.
– Fast Customer Approval: Speed up the credit approval process, ensuring quicker decisions and fewer delays at checkout.
– Accelerate Cash Flow: Get paid faster and lower your DSO.

For more information, visit BlueTape.

Links to the service’s terms of service and privacy policy
Terms of Service: BlueTape Terms
Privacy Policy: BlueTape Privacy Policy

This integration occurs via the API endpoint URLs:
https://beta-api.bluetape.com/genericBthubService (for sandbox environment)
https://api.bluetape.com/genericBthubService (for production environment)
Please ensure you review these links for any legal obligations and details on data usage.

External Service

This plugin uses external services to interact with the BlueTape API for payment gateway processing. These services are necessary to provide seamless transaction processing and related functionalities.

  1. What is the service, and what is it used for?
    The plugin communicates with the BlueTape API for generating invoice checkout redirects. This service allows the plugin to interact with BlueTape’s system to initiate and complete payment transactions.

  2. What data is sent and when?
    The plugin sends order-related data, including the order ID, to the BlueTape API each time a checkout page is triggered. This data is used to generate a redirect link for completing the payment process.

  3. Links to the service’s terms of service and privacy policy

    Privacy Policy: BlueTape Privacy Policy

https://beta-api.bluetape.com/genericBthubService (for sandbox environment)
https://api.bluetape.com/genericBthubService (for production environment)
Please ensure you review these links for any legal obligations and details on data usage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload bluetape-payment-gateway.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > BlueTape Pay to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
How do I set up the plugin?

Simply go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments, select BlueTape Pay, and configure the account details provided by BlueTape.

Is BlueTape secure?

Yes, BlueTape ensures all transactions are secure and comply with industry standards.
